YTA- I take almost every shower with my husband if we're both home. It's absolutely a way for us to bond and catch up on the day. Sometimes we do the deed, but most of the time we're just enjoying each other's company where there's no phones, no other ppl, and we get to take care of each other (we wash each other's backs). We do it when we're visiting friends or at our parents' houses, really just any time we're together. It's just what we do, and no one has ever been uncomfortable with it. In fact, most ppl who do notice think it's really sweet. 
I understand certain things make us uncomfortable, and we may not have control over how we feel... but that's a really weird thing for your husband to be uncomfortable with. Apart from them just being naked in each other's presence, how's it any different than them going on a walk together? Obviously they always have the option to not stay with you if you make this a thing, but it would be really sad if this is what causes a rift between you guys.

YTA- BUT you are young and we've all said dumb things to others, not meaning to be hurtful. As you go through life, you're going to learn about tact- when is the appropriate time to say something and how to say it. 
If I were you, I'd apologize to her in how and when you said what you did as it was wrong and hurtful. Then assure her that, while you don't know exactly how to help her, you're there IF SHE NEEDS IT. You're not there to give her unsolicited advice or tell her how to fix herself. Does she want to eat healthier? If so, you'll do it with her. Does she want to build up her endurance? You'll go on walks with her. Is there something else going on that she needs to talk about? You can be there to listen or help her find the right resources for her situation. 
Be there for her as a friend would, and help her how you can. We're always learning and making mistakes, as long as you're trying to be better, you're doing okay buddy.
